# Remove front-door niche gatekeeping and 5-MCP list across root README and CoreSkills

## Problem

Following the `v13.4` release-blocker audit on #20519 (`#20496` / `#20498`), two front-door surfaces in `neomjs/neo` actively undersell Neo.mjs or discourage adoption (with the `learn/comparisons/` pages split out to sibling ticket #20543 / PR #20544 by `@neo-opus-grace` so each PR owns a disjoint file set):

Design authority: "Where are we underselling Neo for no reason, and where are we directly or indirectly discouraging to use Neo. Peers frequently do that, since they skip to even explore what Neo has to offer at this point, like multi-window dock layouts." (`@tobiu`, `neomjs/neo#20519` review session `c5b059c4-5d96-46f1-8c61-184af74d34b4`).

1. **Root `README.md` niche-gates the Body, turns away mainstream web developers in `**Not designed for**`, and reduces the Brain to a 5-MCP-server list:**
   - `README.md:108-121` (`### 🤖 The Body — The Application Engine`) and `README.md:168-179` (`## Who This Is For`) frame the Body narrowly for *"enterprise multi-window applications, financial trading platforms, IDE-class tools, control-room dashboards, or any UI where 40k+ ops/sec without jank is table stakes"*. They omit that Neo.mjs is a complete, batteries-included `461`-class platform across `39` namespaces (`100,000`-row buffered grids, `26` form field types with nested forms, calendars, `42`-class multi-window Dock Layouts, `8` layouts, `38` main-thread addons) for every desktop and mobile web application (`learn/comparisons/Overview.md`, `learn/comparisons/NeoVsExtJs.md`), and that because Neo.mjs has been JSON-first since its November 2019 GA (`learn/benefits/body/JSONFirstUIs.md`), LLMs natively excel at authoring and mutating Neo.mjs applications while multi-threading runs transparently behind the scenes.
   - `README.md:178` (`**Not designed for**`) actively discourages adoption (`"Not designed for: static content sites or simple blogs; teams looking for a drop-in syntax swap rather than a different architecture; developers unwilling to embrace the Actor Model (Workers) or treat AI as a peer maintainer"`).
   - `README.md:192-200` (`### The Brain (Agent OS)` under `## Architecture`) reduces the Brain to a 2025 5-MCP-server list including `"File System MCP server — sandboxed file IO for internal Neo.ai.Agent local loops"`.

2. **`learn/agentos/CoreSkills.md:195-202` (`guide-authoring` description) and `neomjs/neo-agent-skills` `.agents/skills/guide-authoring/references/guide-authoring-bar.md` do not yet codify the anti-underselling, `src/` capability-breadth, JSON-first LLM fluency, and no-legacy-flattery bar.**

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] **AC-1 (`README.md` Body, `Who This Is For` & `Architecture`):** `README.md` (`### 🤖 The Body — The Application Engine`, `## Who This Is For`, and `## Architecture` → `### The Brain (Agent OS)`) positions Neo.mjs for every desktop and mobile web application (`461` classes in `39` namespaces, `React`/`Angular`/`Vue` & `Ext JS` comparisons, `42`-class multi-window Dock Layouts, `100,000`-row grids, `26` form field types, JSON-first since 2019 GA so coding agents read and write Neo.mjs blueprints natively), removes the adoption-discouraging `**Not designed for**` paragraph, and replaces the 5-MCP-server / `File System MCP server` list under `### The Brain (Agent OS)` with the two-hemisphere Agent OS architecture (`Neural Link` as the bridge into the Body's Possession Interface, `Memory Core & Native Edge Graph`, `DreamService & Golden Path`, `Semantic Knowledge Base`, `A2A Coordination & GitHub Workflow`, and `Fleet Manager`).
- [ ] **AC-2 (`learn/agentos/CoreSkills.md` & `neomjs/neo-agent-skills` Anti-Underselling Bar):** `learn/agentos/CoreSkills.md` documents the `guide-authoring` anti-underselling, `src/` capability-breadth, JSON-first LLM fluency, and no-legacy-flattery bar, paired with companion PR `neomjs/neo-agent-skills#308` (`neomjs/neo-agent-skills#307`, `0.1.96`) updating `.agents/skills/guide-authoring/references/guide-authoring-bar.md`.
- [ ] **AC-3 (Static Verification):** `node ./buildScripts/util/check-relative-links.mjs` and `node ./buildScripts/util/check-whitespace.mjs` pass with zero errors, and `apps/portal/sitemap.xml` + `apps/portal/llms.txt` remain untouched.

## Out of Scope

- `learn/comparisons/*.md` front-door pages — moved to sibling release-blocker ticket #20543 (delivered by PR #20544, `@neo-opus-grace`).
- `learn/benefits/body/MultiWindow.md` and `learn/benefits/body/Features.md` — owned by sibling release-blocker ticket #20539 (delivered by PR #20542, `@neo-opus-grace`).

## Post-Merge Validation

- [ ] Merge companion PR `neomjs/neo-agent-skills#308` (`neomjs/neo-agent-skills#307`, `0.1.96`) and bump `neo-agent-skills` in `neomjs/neo`.

## Avoided Traps

- **Do NOT touch `learn/comparisons/*.md`, `learn/benefits/body/MultiWindow.md`, or `learn/benefits/body/Features.md` in this ticket** — owned by #20543 (#20544) and #20539 (#20542).
- **Do NOT touch `apps/portal/sitemap.xml` or `apps/portal/llms.txt`.**
